disposition_reason: Forty-three elements were measured in 188-208 canned, frozen and fresh mussel samples from the Spanish market; Tables 2-3 give mean, SD, median and quartiles by conservation type.

study.design: market survey of canned, frozen and fresh mussels with dietary intake and risk assessment
study.market: Spanish market, large national suppliers (name and store brands)
study.method: microwave HNO3 digestion; 43 elements by ICP-MS (Agilent 7900) with Sc, Ge, Rh, Ir internal standards
lod: LOD and LOQ defined as 3x and 10x blank signal; numeric values only in supplementary material (not available)
study.qa: method validation recoveries 87-118%; reagent blank every 14 samples; triplicate readings; no CRM named
